links.outcome: Model diagnostic performance versus board-certified emergency physicians on same radiographs
links.effect: Model test accuracy 90.34%, sensitivity 93.5%, specificity 86.8%; physicians accuracy 87.6%, sensitivity 90.5%, specificity 84.7%; differences not statistically significant (P > 0.05).
links.quote: Diagnostic performance differences between the model and physicians were not statistically significant (P > 0.05).

links.outcome: Generalization on patient-level held-out test set and cross-validation; single-source retrospective data
links.effect: Held-out test accuracy 90.34%; five-fold CV mean accuracy 91.72%; authors state prospective multicenter validation is required before clinical deployment.
links.quote: Prospective multicenter validation is required before clinical deployment.

screen.reason: Evaluates a deep learning diagnostic model for pediatric supracondylar humerus fractures on a retrospective test set and in a multireader study comparing model standalone performance against emergency physicians, without evaluating a specific deployment safeguard or workflow intervention.
